ActualGodMode.PrayerRequestDef.label: prayer for food
ActualGodMode.PrayerRequestDef.letterText: {PAWN_nameDef} is hungry and has knelt to pray. "Please, I need something to eat."\n\nCast Food within a few steps of {PAWN_objective} in the next {HOURS} hours to answer. If the prayer goes unanswered, {PAWN_possessive} faith will suffer.

ActualGodMode.PrayerRequestDef.label: prayer for warmth
ActualGodMode.PrayerRequestDef.letterText: {PAWN_nameDef} is freezing. "Please, give me something to burn."\n\nCast Wood within a few steps of {PAWN_objective} in the next {HOURS} hours to answer.

ActualGodMode.PrayerRequestDef.label: prayer against fire
ActualGodMode.PrayerRequestDef.letterText: Fire is spreading near {PAWN_nameDef}! "Put it out, I beg you!"\n\nCast Water near {PAWN_objective} or the fire in the next {HOURS} hours to answer.

ActualGodMode.PrayerRequestDef.label: prayer to be saved
ActualGodMode.PrayerRequestDef.letterText: {PAWN_nameDef} is badly hurt. "Don't let me die here."\n\nCast Heal on {PAWN_objective} in the next {HOURS} hours to answer.

ActualGodMode.PrayerRequestDef.label: wish for rain
ActualGodMode.PrayerRequestDef.letterText: {PAWN_nameDef} looks over the fields. "If the god would bless our crops with rain, we'd all eat well this season."\n\nCast Water on a growing zone in the next {HOURS} hours to grant the wish. The whole colony will be grateful.

ActualGodMode.PrayerRequestDef.label: wish for a sign
ActualGodMode.PrayerRequestDef.letterText: {PAWN_nameDef} has been quiet today. "Sometimes I wonder if anyone is listening. Just a sign. Anything."\n\nWork any miracle in the next {HOURS} hours to grant the wish.
